pages.title: Who We Are
pages.description: Learn about AchiveX LLC, a Wyoming based technology services company, its story, mission, vision and the values that guide its work.

editable.heroText: AchiveX LLC is a technology and business services company based in Wyoming, USA. We help organisations plan, build and run the systems and processes that keep them moving.
editable.heroImageAlt: AchiveX team members collaborating on laptops
storyParagraphs: AchiveX was set up to give growing businesses access to the kind of technology and operations support that larger companies take for granted. Many firms know they need better data, safer systems or more help with daily processes, but they do not have the time or in house skills to sort it out alone.

We bring those capabilities together in one place: strategy, data and analytics, cloud, infrastructure, security and business process services. That means clients can start with one need and add others as they grow, without having to manage a long list of separate vendors.
AchiveX LLC is headquartered in Wyoming, USA.
editable.missionText: To give businesses dependable technology and operations support, explained in plain language and delivered with care.
editable.visionText: A business world where companies of every size can use good technology with confidence, and spend their energy on serving their own customers.

editable.title: Privacy Policy
editable.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how AchiveX LLC collects, uses and protects personal information when you visit our website or contact us.

sections.title: Information we collect
paragraphs: We collect information you give us directly, such as when you complete a contact form, request a download or email us. This can include your name, email address, phone number, company, job title and the content of your message.

When you visit the website, we and our service providers may collect technical information automatically, such as your IP address, browser type, device type, pages viewed and the date and time of your visit.

sections.title: How we use information
paragraphs: We use the information we collect to:
bullets: Respond to enquiries and provide requested documents
Send updates you have asked to receive
Understand how the website is used so we can improve it

paragraphs: The website may use cookies and similar technologies to remember preferences and to measure traffic. You can control cookies through your browser settings. Blocking some cookies may affect how the site works.

sections.title: How we share information
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information. We share it only with service providers who help us run our business, such as hosting, email and analytics providers, and only as needed for them to perform their services. We may also disclose information when required by law.

sections.title: Data retention
paragraphs: We keep personal information only for as long as needed for the purposes described in this policy, or as required by law.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: We use reasonable administrative, technical and physical measures to protect personal information. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: Your choices and rights
paragraphs: Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct or delete your personal information, or to object to certain uses. To make a request, contact us using the details below. You can unsubscribe from marketing emails at any time using the link in the email.

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: This website is not directed to children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect their personal information.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last changed.

pages.title: Web Development
pages.description: Fast, mobile friendly websites built to turn visitors into customers. WordPress, WooCommerce, Laravel and React websites that load quickly and make it easy to get in touch or buy.
pages.content: A website has one main job: help the right visitors take the next step, whether that is calling you, booking a meeting or placing an order. We plan each site around that step, then build it to load quickly and work properly on every phone. We build on WordPress and WooCommerce when you want to edit content yourself, and on custom PHP, Laravel or React when the site needs features an off the shelf setup cannot handle. Redesigns of existing sites, speed work and ongoing maintenance are part of the service. Page structure and content plan based on your goals Design for desktop, tablet and phone WordPress and WooCommerce builds you can edit yourself Custom PHP, Laravel and React development Speed optimization and basic technical SEO setup Hosting setup, backups and ongoing maintenance Built to convert. Clear pages, simple forms and visible calls to action make it easy for visitors to contact you or buy. Fast on every device. Images, code and hosting are tuned so pages load quickly on phones as well as desktops. Easy to update. You can change text, images and products yourself without calling a developer for every edit. Looked after. Updates, backups and fixes continue after launch, so the site keeps working. How long does a new website take? Most business websites take four to ten weeks. Online stores and custom builds can take longer. We give you a timeline after the first consultation. Can you redesign our existing site? Yes. We can keep what works, improve what does not and move your content across without losing pages that already rank. WordPress or custom code? WordPress suits most marketing sites and stores. Custom Laravel or React suits sites with complex features. We recommend one based on what you need, not on habit. How much does a website cost? It depends on the number of pages, features and content. We quote a fixed price after a free consultation.

pages.title: Custom Software
pages.description: Web apps, SaaS platforms, dashboards, admin panels and APIs built around your business. Software shaped around how your team works, built on Laravel and React.
pages.content: Off the shelf tools cover common needs, but many businesses end up stitching together spreadsheets and apps that do not talk to each other. Custom software replaces that with one system built for your process. We build web apps, SaaS platforms, internal systems, dashboards, admin panels and APIs on Laravel and React. Each project starts with how your team works today and grows in small, usable releases. Discovery workshops and written requirements Web applications and SaaS platforms Internal systems and admin panels Dashboards and reporting screens APIs and integrations with your existing tools Testing, deployment and ongoing support Fits your process. Screens and steps follow how your team works instead of forcing a new routine. One source of truth. Data lives in one system rather than scattered spreadsheets and apps. You own it. The code and data belong to you, with no per seat licence for the core system. Grows with you. New features are added in small releases as the business changes. How long does a custom system take? A first usable version usually takes eight to sixteen weeks. Larger platforms are built in stages after that. Which technologies do you use? Mainly Laravel for the back end and React for the front end, with standard hosting and databases. Can it connect to the tools we already use? Usually yes, through APIs. We check each tool during discovery. Who owns the code? You do. The code and data are handed over and documented.

pages.title: AI & Automation
pages.description: Chatbots, document parsing, lead scoring, AI agents and a 24/7 AI receptionist, connected to the tools you already use. Practical AI and automation built on your own data, aimed at the work that takes your team the most time.
pages.content: Much of the work in a growing business is repetitive: reading documents, sorting enquiries, answering the same questions and copying information from one system to another. We find those tasks and build AI tools and automations that handle them the same way every time. Our work covers document parsing, prediction and lead scoring, retrieval based AI and custom chatbots that answer from your own documents, integration between your tools, AI agents for routine tasks, and a 24/7 AI receptionist that answers calls, books appointments and qualifies leads. Review of tasks where AI and automation can save time Document parsing, prediction and lead scoring Custom chatbots and retrieval based AI on your own data Integration between your apps, forms, email and CRM AI agents and workflow automation for routine tasks 24/7 AI receptionist for calls, appointments and lead qualification Hours back each week. Repetitive reading, sorting and copying is handled by the system. Answers from your data. Chatbots and assistants respond using your own documents and records. No missed calls. The AI receptionist answers out of hours and books appointments. Connected systems. Your tools share information instead of working in isolation. Will our data be used to train public AI models? No. We set up systems so your data stays within the services and accounts you control. Which tools can you connect? Most modern tools with an API, such as CRMs, booking systems, email, forms and spreadsheets. We confirm each one at the start. How does the AI receptionist work? It answers calls with a script you approve, answers common questions, books appointments in your calendar and passes qualified leads to your team. What does it cost? It depends on scope. We usually start with one focused tool or automation, quoted after a free consultation.

pages.title: SEO
pages.description: Technical, on-page, local and off-page SEO with monthly reporting. Help the right customers find you on Google, then turn that traffic into enquiries.
pages.content: Search engine optimization is steady work across the whole site: making it easy for Google to read, making each page useful for the people searching, and building trust through mentions and links from other sites. We cover technical, on-page, local and off-page SEO, optimize your Google Business Profile and send a monthly report, so you can see how rankings, organic traffic and qualified leads are changing. Technical SEO audit and fixes Keyword research and on-page optimization Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization Content planning for pages and articles Off-page SEO and quality link building Monthly ranking, traffic and lead reports More qualified traffic. Pages target the searches your customers actually make. Local visibility. An optimized Google Business Profile helps you show up in local results and maps. A healthy site. Technical fixes make the site faster and easier for search engines to read. Clear reporting. Monthly reports show what changed and what we are doing next. How long until we see results? Technical fixes can help within weeks. Ranking for competitive searches usually takes several months of steady work. Can you guarantee first place on Google? No one can honestly guarantee a ranking. We focus on the work that improves visibility and report on progress every month. Do you write content? Yes. We plan and write pages and articles, or work with content your team provides. How is SEO priced? Usually as a monthly retainer based on the size of the site and the competition. We quote after a free consultation.
